entities.name: Non-3GPP NW policies
entities.description: Information element used by the network to indicate whether emergency numbers provided via non-3GPP access can be used to initiate UE detected emergency calls.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that handles registration procedures and includes/excludes information elements.

entities.name: Registration procedure over non-3GPP access
entities.description: Registration procedure performed over non-3GPP access network.

entities.name: Network needs to indicate emergency number usage
entities.description: Condition where the network needs to indicate whether emergency numbers provided via non-3GPP access can be used for UE detected emergency calls.

entities.name: IE not included interpretation
entities.description: When the IE is not included, the UE shall interpret this as receiving an information element with all bits of the value part coded as zero.

relations.description: AMF shall not include this IE during registration procedure over non-3GPP access.
The IE is included if the network needs to indicate emergency number usage via non-3GPP access.
When IE is not included, UE interprets it as receiving IE with all bits coded as zero.
Registration procedure over non-3GPP access restricts inclusion of this IE.
